Subject: Renewal engagement: term options, capacity runway, and QBR scheduling

Hi Asha / Ravi —

Thanks again for the productive check-in last week. Per our conversation, I want to kick off the formal renewal engagement and outline a lightweight plan so we can lock terms and capacity before your end-of-June procurement window. High-level ask: confirm which term & capacity path you prefer so we can prepare pricing/contract language and a QBR to align stakeholders.

Proposed timeline (rough):
- Week of May 28: agreement on target term (12 / 24 / 36 months) and uplift baseline (tokens/day or reserved capacity).
- Week of June 3: pricing & legal redlines circulated; internal capacity reservations placed.
- Week of June 10: exec QBR to finalize SLAs, support onboarding schedule, and sign.

Initial decisions we need from you this week:
1) Preferred term length (12/24/36).
2) Expected peak daily throughput (RPS or tokens/day) for next 12 months — helps sizing.
3) Stakeholders to include in the QBR (procurement, security, platform).

I've attached a short renewal playbook and an availability survey for QBR times. Ben will prepare a capacity forecast based on the numbers you share; Camila will own the legal/terms draft.

Attachments: [Renewal_Playbook_v1.pdf], [QBR_availability_survey.docx]

Next step: reply with preferred term + one line on expected peak capacity and three people to include in the QBR. If easier, propose two 60-min slots next week and I'll lock one.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this in motion.

—
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Quick answers from our side:
1) We're leaning toward a 24-month term (gives us pricing stability).
2) For sizing: current peak is ~15M tokens/day; forecasted growth to ~28M tokens/day by Q4 with a new feature launch in August. We need 20% headroom for burst.
3) Please include: me (Asha, Product Lead), Ravi (Platform Lead), and Priya Shah (Procurement — priya.shah@astracare.ai).

Two windows that work for the exec QBR next week (Pacific time):
- Wed June 5, 11:00–12:00 PT
- Thu June 6, 14:00–15:00 PT

One ask: can you share the impact on pricing if we commit to reserved capacity vs. a blended usage model? Also want to confirm data residency and audit log retention options for our compliance team.

Appreciate the playbook — I’ll forward to Priya.

Best,
